surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Four-page libadwaita preferences dialog ordered General, Appearance, Editor, and Source Control. General owns app language and autosave, Appearance owns app style, editor palette tiles, and the editor font, Editor keeps view toggles, indentation, and an expander row holding the large-file thresholds, and Source Control owns local Git identity. Per-document encoding and line endings live in the status-bar document-format menu.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: Rows stay vertically stacked, ComboRows use standard inline choices, SpinRows keep their numeric editor inline without horizontal scrolling, the large-file SpinRows sit inside an AdwExpanderRow and remain bounded and ordered by code sanitization, Appearance palette grids wrap within their page, and the Source Control identity rows remain separate from editor controls while keeping standard row labels.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Standard shortcuts window grouped into app, file, project, tabs, search, view, and compare actions, including Open Folder, Refresh Project Tree, and GNOME tab navigation shortcuts.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: Shortcut groups continue stacking in reading order as width tightens.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Single-window editor shell with a header bar, an overlay project sidebar for folder navigation, a runtime-inserted search bar above the tabs, per-tab banners for ongoing file state, optional minimaps inside tab content, a tabbed workspace, and a bottom status bar with document location, format, zoom, and cursor status.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: Header actions stay reachable while the project sidebar can be shown or hidden without displacing the editor, the search rows stack above the tabs, per-tab banners stay above editor content, the minimap remains a narrow fixed strip when enabled without taking over the layout, and the bottom status bar keeps the location, format, zoom, and cursor readouts reachable at narrow widths.

surfaces.adaptive_pattern: Centered window title reflects the selected tab title while the full file location lives in the bottom status bar.
surfaces.collapse_behavior: The title truncates naturally before it displaces primary header-bar actions.

css.reason: Theme selector swatches, editor palette preview tiles, and the Source Control active-file highlight need compact visual affordances not provided by default Adwaita rows.
css.scope: Riteed-prefixed classes used by the Appearance popover, the preferences palette grid, and the Source Control row matching the selected tab.

css.reason: Compare rendering and editor Source Control minimap bands resolve libadwaita semantic colors for transient text-buffer diff tags through harmless CSS probe widgets.
css.scope: Riteed-prefixed color probe classes used only for compare and editor Source Control minimap tag color lookup.
